subject: Leadership readout: mid-quarter trajectory sync, rescope proposals & resource requests
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership readout: mid-quarter trajectory sync, rescope proposals & resource requests

Team —

Quick mid-run check. I updated the QBR readout draft (attached) and want to align on a small set of asks so the exec package is clean next week. High-level: our customer-traffic experiments on the new batching heuristics are positive but not uniformly across workloads; two infra features (KV cache eviction tuning + multi-model kernel fallback) are late and directly affect Q3 throughput targets.

What I need from leadership for the readout:
- Agreement on one strategic rescope to protect the top-of-funnel SLA (proposal below).
- Approval to reallocate 2x FTE from platform infra to serving runtime for 6 weeks (temporary) or alternatively a priority swap from feature backlog.
- Permission to surface a limited service-level exception to Acme Payments for the rest of this quarter while we finish the KV tuning.

Rescope proposal (short): move two non-critical UX polish items out of Q3 sprint 1, retain the customer-observable batching improvements and the model-fallback rollout. This buys ~3 weeks of execution runway for the kernel fallback.

I've attached a dependency matrix with impacted owners and a proposed execution timeline. Please review and call out any immediate objections.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick leadership vote (Ack/Obj) by EOD Thursday;
2) If Ack, Marissa to own exec note and Naomi to coordinate customer comms;
3) Markus to scope the FTE swap plan and list the exact engineers.

Thanks —
Sofia
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: QBR_readout_draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB), dependency_matrix_2026Q3.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership readout: mid-quarter trajectory sync, rescope proposals & resource requests

Sofia — thanks for the clear summary. Quick notes from infra constraints:

- The KV eviction tuning is larger than the headline; it touches cache metrics + two downstream dashboards. I can spin up a two-week focused pass with one senior infra and one junior, but that won't deliver the kernel fallback timeline you noted. To hit your 3-week slip protection we'd need the 2x FTE for 6 weeks you mentioned.

- Alternative trade: we could drop the non-critical UX items and also defer the experimental multi-model routing work (this reduces scope surface and lets one more runtime engineer pivot to KV tuning). That would only require 1x FTE reallocation.

Operational ask: I need the final list of who we can move (names) and a clear rollback plan in case production regressions appear. Also flagging that PilotCloud marketplace integration has an upcoming test window (w/c 7/20) — if we pull the same engineers, that partner deliverable slips.

Ack/No Obj for rescope if we commit to the 1x or 2x FTE plan and we get a binding decision by Friday EOD.

-Markus
Director, Platform Infrastructure

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership readout: mid-quarter trajectory sync, rescope proposals & resource requests

Sofia / Markus —

I support a constrained rescope but want to propose a more surgical version:

1) Defer the UX polish A (low impact) and the internationalized help text task (non-customer-facing this quarter).
2) Keep the experimental multi-model routing in the backlog but switch to a "pilot-only" rollout for 1% traffic (so we collect telemetry without broad exposure).
3) Approve temporary 1x FTE reallocation (senior infra) for four weeks; re-evaluate after telemetry from the KV tuning.

Rationale: less organizational churn, keeps pilot forward motion, and reduces marketplace partner risk Markus mentioned. If the telemetry from pilot shows regressions, we can escalate to 2x FTE and issue the limited exception to Acme.

I can draft the exec slide that frames the trade-offs (short bullets + 1 slide with customer impact).

-Vanessa
VP, Product Operations

Key action items I've captured:

All —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Leadership consensus: approve the constrained rescope plus a temporary 1x FTE reallocation for four weeks with a telemetry gate at week 3. If telemetry shows positive delta but still short of targets, we escalate to 2x FTE commitment and permit the limited service-level exception to Acme with a short customer note.

Action items for this thread (owners & dates):
- Markus: circulate candidate engineer names by EOD Wednesday 7/15 and confirm PilotCloud test window coverage plan.
- Vanessa: finalize the one-slide trade-off and send to Marissa by 7/15 noon.
- Marissa: update QBR deck and incorporate the approved ask (slide + speaker notes) by 7/16.
- Naomi: draft the customer comms for Acme + PilotCloud and run it by legal; target internal review 7/16.
- Sofia: update the dependency matrix and final timeline (deliverable to execs 7/17).

I'll publish the short leadership note after I receive the engineer names and the slide. Good work moving quickly here — keep the draft crisp and no surprises in the readout.

Naomi Feldman
VP, Customer Success & GTM Ops
